limitations: Static repository screenshots and original labelled video stills; production auto controller receives first readable sample then samples every 100ms. Fresh Chrome profile per sample; cold includes local worker/model startup after first sample. Warm starts with both fast and standard fallback workers initialized; each warmup is recorded outside timing, without a recognition pre-read. Exact names and signed values required. Complete latency requires labelled category, detected Hall, labelled five star states, 100% production capture meter, a rendered comparison and two requestAnimationFrame callbacks. Fixtures without category/Hall/star truth report partial stats only. Fresh-craft dice eligibility is production inference, not independently pixel labelled. Screenshot loading, seed setup, navigation, screen-share permission, game animation and persistence completion are outside timing. Log synchronous serialization/render costs remain inside timing. Small sample p95 is descriptive, not representative field performance. Compare matched fixture groups; aggregate complete latency excludes failed cases and must not compare different sets of completed fixtures.
